author: Russell Brand
description:
Russell Brand and Tommy Robinson discuss the growing role of governments in shaping the flow of information during times of political tension and conflict. The conversation turns to claims about how military-linked units, including the UK’s 77th Brigade, have been used to monitor online spaces, counter disinformation, and influence the broader information environment.
